questions.question: Are all aerial lifts properly inspected before use each day?  (Include at least five pictures/PDFs of aerial lift inspections from this week)

Is anyone using personal fall arrest equipment?  If YES, has it been properly inspected and does it properly fit the worker? (Include pictures of workers properly set up in and using their fall protection equipment)

Is fall protection equipment appropriate for the situation?  Lanyards - Type 1 for anchor above D-Ring, Type 2 for anchor above or below D-Ring.  Sharp or leading edge protection.  Proper length or type.
